column1: # Records that are BINDING AND FLAGGED: in force, relied upon, and carrying a visible
# obligation to supply the missing opinion. NOT void, NOT stayed, NOT deleted (D2).
# This file may only SHRINK. The gate compares it EXACTLY against what it finds, so a NEW
# flagged record fails AND an entry that is no longer real also fails until it is removed.
# The second limb is the one that matters: it is what stops a register becoming a place
# where obligations go to be forgotten.
# obligation_since is the date the obligation AROSE, per Denning: an obligation without a
# date is an obligation nobody is failing.
